title: FileRelocatedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'file.relocated'. Emitted instead of delete+add when the scanner re-links a moved/renamed media_files row to its existing item via content-hash identity (docs/PLAN.md §5, §8.2, P8) — watch state is preserved.

contentHash.description: xxHash3 of first+last 4 MiB + size, the identity hint used to match the file.
